briefing: NASDAQ +2.1% and S&P 500 +1.8% signal a broad risk-on day, so we deployed cash into our three open slots following the highest-conviction momentum setups. AAPL, ASST, and RIOT all show confirmed MACD crossovers with price above their 20-day averages; existing positions are held unchanged.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like a bullish MACD crossover, RSI in a healthy range, and price trading above its moving average — to align before buying, rather than acting on just one indicator. Using several signals together reduces the chance of chasing a false or short-lived move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前等待多個技術訊號同時出現,例如MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於健康區間,以及股價高於其移動平均線,而不是單憑一個指標就進場。同時參考多項訊號可以降低追高或誤判短暫波動的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Markets rallied broadly today with the NASDAQ up 2.1% and the S&P 500 up 1.8%, reflecting a risk-on tone across growth and tech-adjacent names. No specific news catalysts were provided for today, so the move appears driven by broad momentum and sector-wide buying rather than a single headline event. This kind of synchronized advance across major indices is typically associated with improving investor sentiment and risk appetite.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍上揚,納斯達克指數升2.1%,標普500指數升1.8%,反映市場風險胃納回升,資金傾向流入科技及相關增長股。今日未有提供具體新聞催化劑,此輪升勢看來是由大盤動能及板塊性買盤帶動,而非單一事件推動。主要指數同步上揚,通常意味著投資者信心及風險偏好正在改善。
